summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, when the Bun runtime is not already present, downloads a Bun release zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then execFileSyncs the sibling file math_init.js under that freshly downloaded Bun runtime. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (obfuscator.io string-array rotator plus a ~1000-entry decoder table) whose content cannot be statically inspected without executing the rotator. The package is published under the @servicetitan scope and advertises a Kendo React grid wrapper; a Bun-executed obfuscated payload of this size and shape has no relationship to that declared functionality. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time specifically to execute an opaque bundled blob on every installer is an install-time remote code execution dropper, and the @servicetitan/* scope with peerDependencies on other @servicetitan/* packages functions as namespace-impersonation cover targeting consumers of that internal library set.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
